hypothesis: Actual selected fifth-effect observation should lower heldout return-action regret for neural Hybrid dynamics+planning relative to the same model with that factual observation erased; compare equally budgeted fixed/random probes and trained native-direct, GRU, SSM factual-result learning; preserve scripted analytical comparator as strongest upper bound.

design.task: R29 exact known analytical public-context-dependent action law, with no hidden q fed to learners
design.fit_source: new independently generated synthetic FIT groups; never use registered R29 DEV/OOD groups or original F7/CausalGym
design.fit_probe_actions: both selected factual fifth actions crossed per public context, not hidden q
design.evaluation_from: R29 new analytic calibration generator; heldout B histories and q sign crossed, no score training
design.input_encoding: original 16D action key and physical observed-effect vectors; public context and goal in auxiliary state channels; final candidate effect strictly zero-masked
design.erasure: zero only the selected factual fifth effect, preserve selected fifth action, B and early facts
design.matched_group_cluster: 12 groups × public context 0/1 × hidden sign -/+; deterministic paired group bootstrap

train.objective: selected factual final return only; dynamics predicts physically observed normalized displacement; direct predicts scaled realized squared-goal error from selected return, not oracle labels; same sampled FIT rows for all
